name: moneybird-mcp-server
description: Connect Claude to Moneybird accounting software. List contacts, invoices, products, projects, time entries, and make custom API requests.
long_description: A Model Context Protocol server that connects AI assistants to Moneybird accounting software via API. Manage contacts, sales invoices, estimates, recurring invoices, products, projects, time entries, financial accounts, and ledger accounts. Supports server-side filtering, pagination, and custom API requests to any Moneybird endpoint.

tools.name: moneybird_list
tools.description: List entities from Moneybird (contacts, sales_invoices, estimates, recurring_sales_invoices, products, projects, time_entries, financial_accounts, ledger_accounts). Supports filtering and pagination.

tools.name: moneybird_get
tools.description: Get a single entity by ID from Moneybird (contact, sales_invoice, estimate, product, project, time_entry, etc.).

tools.name: moneybird_request
tools.description: Make a custom Moneybird API request with any HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) to any Moneybird endpoint.

api_token.title: Moneybird API Token
api_token.description: Your Moneybird API token. Generate one at https://moneybird.com/user/applications

administration_id.title: Moneybird Administration ID
administration_id.description: Your Moneybird administration ID. Found in the URL when logged in: https://moneybird.com/[YOUR_ADMINISTRATION_ID]/
